otp.description: The OTP inputted by the user

verified.description: Whether the OTP was verified or not

name.description: Your app's name (customizes message to 'Your [name] code is...')

otp_id.description: The OTP's ID. Use it to refer to this verification in the future, such as when verifying the OTP or resending it.

200.description: Cancel an active Reverse OTP session
Poll the status of a Reverse OTP session

number.description: Phone number that texted the factor. Null until verified if you did not provide an expected number at initiate.
Optional. Expected sender phone number in E.164. If omitted, Contiguity learns the number from the inbound message — the user never has to type it.

to.description: Phone number to text. If you lease a number from Contiguity, you can enter it here. Defaults to a random Contiguity-owned number.

service.description: Messaging service to receive the code on. Defaults to SMS. iMessage requires an active iMessage-capable number on your account.

success_url.description: Override the default webhook URL for otp.reverse.verified. By default, Contiguity will use your existing webhook preferences.

200.description: Start a Reverse OTP verification session. Pass `number` only if you already know the sender and want to require that exact phone. Omit it to discover the number from the inbound message.

number.description: Sender number being verified. Null until a matching message arrives if you did not provide one at initiate.

factor.description: 6-character alphanumeric code the user must text. Generated by Contiguity.

text.example: Text ABC123 to +1 (646) 555-0123 to verify your phone number.

qr_code.description: QR code payload – use your favorite QR code generation library to encode this URL

success_url.description: Webhook URL used to notify your app when Contiguity verifies the user's phone number
